PBP 2027 requires a complete 200-300-400-600 km brevet series in 2027 (pre-registration priority based on 2026 brevet distance); RUSA membership for RUSA events

Date2027 is a Paris-Brest-Paris year (PBP is held in France in mid/late August 2027; Hoodoo 500 moved its date to avoid it). In PBP years US clubs typically run fewer 1200ks; candidates to check on rusa.org include Cascade 1200/1400 (Seattle International Randonneurs), Colorado High Country 1200 (Rocky Mountain Cycling Club), Endless Mountains 1240 (PA Randonneurs), Big Wild Ride 1200 (Alaska), Texas Rando Stampede 1200 and Taste of Carolina 1200. Gold Rush Randonnee (Davis Bike Club) runs on a 4-year cycle and is not expected in 2027.
